mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.2% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.5% indicates severe economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns as corporate earnings face downward pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 9.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint weakness in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a broad-based demand contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns due to reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: The joint effect of RSAFS and HOUST on SPX 20-day returns is not significant (p>0.05) in a regression over a 3-year rolling window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns as corporate earnings growth slows.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is declining (INDPRO < previous month) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPI reading above 217.5 signals accelerating inflation, prompting negative S&P 500 forward returns as the Federal Reserve may tighten monetary policy to combat inflation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 217.5 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (high PAYEMS) supports consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days without specific threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS is above the 50th percentile over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing market activity (HOUST > 550) reflects strong consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns as corporate earnings benefit from robust demand.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 550 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 217.5) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.2%) signals delayed monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns due to inflation fears.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 217.5 and FEDFUNDS < 0.2 over a 3-year rolling window.
